title: Investigation response
description: PERD §39.2: the response of GET /v1/investigations/{investigation_id}, the current state for the overlay: {state, last_answer, case_ref_masked?}, with schema_version (PERD §39.1: bodies carry it). 'state' is one of six public stages (ruling A187: the client never receives the 21 internal investigation states of PERD §28.2; the core maps its states to these, and the plain-language strings are the frontend owner's). 'last_answer' is absent until a final answer exists. 'case_ref_masked' is shown only after case_opened is ACHIEVED and shows at most four digits in all, of any script (A187, A154). New in this contract set; no earlier contract changes (AGENT-15).

PublicStage.description: Where the investigation stands, in six words the customer can be told (ruling A187). UNDERSTANDING: reading the request. CHECKING: reading and comparing records, evaluating, waiting for a bounded condition. NEEDS_YOU: a question or a confirmation waits for the customer. ACTING: an approved action is being carried out or verified. HANDED_TO_TEAM: a person has the case. FINISHED: the investigation has ended; the final text, if any, is last_answer. FINISHED says nothing about success.
